title: Situation Routing
description: Reusable site pattern for businesses whose commercial navigation is organized around distinct client situations, problems or jobs rather than a generic service catalog.

pages.purpose: Present one distinct client situation/problem and lead it toward the appropriate commercial route.

constraints: Do not turn situation routing into a generic service catalog.
Distinct primary demand or search intents may require separate route pages.
Internal segmentation or demand IDs must not automatically become public labels.
Wording may vary, but the route semantics must be preserved.
